samples.text: Vendor may terminate this Agreement immediately without notice if Customer fails to pay any invoice or in its sole discretion.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the other party fails to cure within 30 days after written notice.
Customer's liability for payment obligations and breaches is unlimited. Vendor's total cumulative aggregate liability shall not exceed fifty dollars ($50.00).
In no event shall either party's aggregate liability exceed the total fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
Customer hereby irrevocably assigns to Vendor all right, title, and interest in and to all deliverables, custom code, inventions, and patent rights.
Customer shall retain sole ownership of all custom deliverables created under the applicable Statement of Work.
Customer may not assign this Agreement without Vendor's prior written consent. Vendor may freely assign this Agreement to any successor or affiliate without notice.
Neither party may assign this Agreement without consent, except to an affiliate or successor in connection with a merger or sale of assets.
Customer agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor against any and all losses, liabilities, costs, and full attorney fees.
Each party shall indemnify the other for third-party claims arising from gross negligence or material breach, subject to prompt written notice.
Each party agrees to maintain in strict confidence all proprietary information received from the other party and use it solely to perform obligations.
During the term and for a period of five (5) years following termination, Customer shall not directly or indirectly develop competing software products.
Neither party shall solicit for employment any personnel directly involved in the project for a period of twelve (12) months following termination.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and the parties consent to exclusive jurisdiction in Delaware state and federal courts.
Undisputed invoices are due and payable within thirty (30) days of receipt. Late fees of 1.5% per month may apply to overdue balances.
Vendor shall be Customer's sole provider of enterprise cloud analytics services, and Customer shall not purchase from any other vendor.
Customer shall grant Vendor unrestricted audit access to all facilities, accounting records, and source code at any time without prior notice.
Upon any change of control, merger, or acquisition of Customer, Vendor may immediately terminate this Agreement without liability.
Vendor guarantees that all pricing offered to Customer shall be no less favorable than the most favored customer terms granted to any other commercial client.
Customer assigns all rights in any derivative works, enhancements, or bug fixes developed during the performance of services to Vendor.
